answer: PoA refracts every fault through a correlation prism: the slash grows with how many identities commit the same fault together. A lone sparrow that double-signs pays a feather - a small fine. But puppets faulting in lockstep concentrate into one beam, and the penalty multiplies super-linearly, devouring the whole stake. The only escape is faking independence: randomizing behavior per puppet costs as much real work as N honest identities. Honest users pay once and rarely trip the wire; sybils march together into the canyon of correlated slashing, or apart - gaining nothing from numbers.
